## Kind of change

- [ ] Wording / clarification — **no behavior change**
- [ ] Behavior change to the format (discussed in an issue first?)
- [ ] Conformance case added or changed
- [ ] Tooling, CI, or docs outside the specification

## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) — see [CONTRIBUTING](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `python3 .github/scripts/check-conformance.py` passes
- [ ] New conformance cases have a `manifest.json` entry and fail for exactly one reason
- [ ] No released version directory was edited (`spec/1.0/` is frozen except for errata)
- [ ] New examples use the fictional `example/1` catalog
